quest.title: Versus Yasuhiko Tarou
quest.description: Claiming that he was "born for combat," and with his head full of strange thoughts, Yasuhiko Tarou seeks a duel with you at last.

dialogues.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
dialogues.text: I greatly look forward to this duel. I wonder what the extent of your skills is.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uh, what are you doing here...

dialogues.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
dialogues.text: Actually, when I said previously that 4 warriors had joined, I was including myself in that list.

dialogues.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
dialogues.text: I'm the organizer, yes, but there were just too few participants...

dialogues.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
dialogues.text: And anyway, I was born for combat! Since there is a mighty foe before me, I must have my duel!

dialogues.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
dialogues.text: ...Hehe, I've been waiting to say that for a long time now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, Paimon's not sure this person is right in the head.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Best not to underestimate him all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
dialogues.text: Exactly! Your desire to show no partiality to your foes fills me with respect for you!

dialogues.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
dialogues.text: Previously, if I had not looked down on our fourth contestant, I would not have suffered such a terrible defeat.

dialogues.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
dialogues.text: #But the man I am today is not the man I was yesterday! Come on then, {NICKNAME}, let us duel!

choices.text: Give me a second to prepare.

response.speaker: Yasuhiko Tarou
response.text: I understand. Take your time to prepare.
